name: Drop to floor

input.prompt: A person drops straight down from a short height, lands with both feet in a deep superhero crouch, absorbing the impact with bent knees, then rises to stand upright facing forward.

edits: Editor-authored flight path and web effect

name: Shoot web

input.prompt: A person standing upright thrusts their right arm diagonally upward and forward with an open palm, like a superhero shooting a web from the wrist. The left arm balances behind. Hold the right arm extended upward.

edits: Editor-authored flight path and web effect

name: Swing and land

input.prompt: A person reaches their right arm overhead, hangs from one hand with bent knees and swings their body forward. They release their grip, drop down, land on both feet in a low crouch, then stand up.

edits: Editor-authored flight path and web effect
